headline: Indian Markets Pause After Seven-Day Rally as Sensex and Nifty End Muhurat Trading Session Marginally Lower

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Sensex and Nifty snapped a seven-day winning streak during the Diwali Muhurat trading session.
Indian stocks posted their best weekly gain in six years despite a global technology sell-off.
Muhurat trading ended nearly flat, with Sensex closing at 80,999 and Nifty settling at 24,986.
Stock-specific news and key market factors are setting the tone for trading action on Monday.
whatHappening: Muhurat trading session saw Sensex and Nifty end marginally lower after a consecutive seven-day rally.
Tata Motors leads Mahindra & Mahindra in the passenger vehicle race powered by EV sales performance.
Key stocks including Wipro, Zee Entertainment, Asian Paints, Marico, JSW Energy, and Voltas are in focus today.
Indian stock markets bucked global tech declines to record strong weekly gains ahead of the Diwali session.
summary:
Indian stock markets paused their seven-day winning rally as Sensex and Nifty closed marginally lower in the Diwali Muhurat trading session.
Despite the minor dip, Indian equities recently logged their best weekly performance in six years while bucking a broader global technology sell-off.
Stock-specific movement is expected today across key counters including Tata Motors, Wipro, Zee Entertainment, and Asian Paints.
